After you recruit the gith, you can click on it to get the following set of questions. The gith will always be semi-hostile at this point. She comes from a hostile land and has been infected by her mortal enemy; she is not here to make friends.

Lae'zel has just been recruited but remains cold and semi‑hostile: a proud, blunt Githyanki who is infected by a tadpole and still loyal to Vlaakith. You and she share a recent, traumatic mind‑link from the Crèche Y'llek (the player was captured), so memories of the artefact/dream have just flowed into her and left her feeling betrayed. She fears being branded a traitor (Hshar'lak) and hunted by her own, so she scorns apologies and demands a full, unvarnished account of what you saw inside the artefact. This short post‑recruitment exchange reflects her mistrust, cultural arrogance, and unresolved infection rather than a desire to befriend the party.

Lae'zel confronts a tiefling that has seen another githyanki. She tries to prise the information from him with intimidation, perhaps insisting he bow to show proper deference. Key emotions: Lae'zel is arrogant and fearsome; Zorru is afraid she will attack, but tries not to show it - at first.

Companion Lae'zel or (alt gith if Laezel is avatar) will approach the player after spotting the player as she spies on some imps. During the dialogue she has a mindmeld with the player but brushes it aside.
context: You have just recruited Lae'zel, a proud, militaristic Githyanki who remains cold and semi‑hostile; she is infected by a tadpole (her people's mortal enemy) and still loyal to Vlaakith. Off‑screen the two of you shared a recent, traumatic mind‑link at the Crèche Y'llek when the player was captured, and the visions from an artefact/dream flowed into Lae'zel. Those memories left her feeling betrayed and terrified of being branded Hshar'lak (traitor) and hunted by her own, so she dismisses apologies and demands a full, unvarnished account of what you saw inside the artefact. In these lines the player either apologizes for not taking her or remains silent while Lae'zel angrily presses for details.
